abapRelease.description: Target ABAP Cloud release, e.g. "2508". When set, constructs whose SAP-documented minimum release is newer are reported as warnings (rule RAP900) from the bundled, dated feature table. Omit to skip release gating.

files.description: The BDEF/SRVD files to check, plus any .ddls.asddls or base .bdef.asbdef you want cross-checked in the same call. Up to 32 files, 100k chars each — passing the base BDEF and the CDS views is what turns on the cross-file half of the rule set.

filename.description: abapGit-style name — "zr_travel.bdef.asbdef", "zui_travel_v4.srvd.srvdsrv", "zr_travel.ddls.asddls". Omit it and the kind is inferred from the source; pass it whenever you have it, because cross-file checks (projection → base, expose → CDS entity) key off names.

source.description: The complete behavior-definition, service-definition or CDS source text.

strict.description: Run the strict-mode rules even when the BDEF does not declare strict/strict(2) — use it to see what a BO would have to fix before it can be released under the C0/C1 contract. Default false: strict rules run only on BDEFs that declare strict.

name: check_rap_behavior

files.description: One row per supplied file: what it was taken to be, and whether it parsed.

entityCount.description: BDEF only: "define"/"extend behavior for" blocks found.

filename.description: The name as passed in, or one inferred from the source.

kind.description: What the file was treated as. "unsupported" = neither BDEF, SRVD nor CDS; nothing was checked.

parsed.description: True when the file reduced to an AST with no punctuation-level errors.

parserErrors.description: Parse diagnostics for this file — the RAP-PARSE findings, per file.

kind.description: "syntax" = punctuation-level breakage (an error); "unknown-construct" = outside our grammar (info).

message.description: What the parser could not reduce, in plain words.

findings.description: Every rule finding, sorted by file, line, column, rule id.

confidence.description: Provenance of the rule itself — only 'confirmed' rules are ever severity error.

entity.description: The behavior entity or service the finding is scoped to, when it has one.

hint.description: The concrete fix, as BDL you can paste.

message.description: What is wrong, naming the entity/field involved.

minRelease.description: ABAP Cloud release the construct needs, on release-gated findings.

severity.description: error = confirmed defect; warning = advisory or release-gated; info = a checker-coverage note.

sourceUrl.description: The SAP page the rule was derived from.

grammarVersion.description: Which BDL/SDL grammar read the files, e.g. "bdl/2026-09-10".

releaseGate.description: Present only when abapRelease was passed.

curatedDate.description: When the bundled feature-table transcription was curated.

gatedConstructs.description: How many constructs needed a newer release than the target.

rulesVersion.description: Which rule set judged them, e.g. "rap-rules/1.0.0".

scopeNote.description: Exactly what this checker proves and does not prove — abaplint did not parse these files, and ADT remains the authority.

summary.description: Counts, including the two honesty counters that make coverage gaps measurable.

baseUnresolved.description: How often a cross-file rule stayed silent because the projection's CDS view names a base entity no BDEF in this call defines — pass that BDEF to turn those rules on.

errors.description: Findings at severity error — confirmed defects.

filesChecked.description: Files that were BDEF, SRVD or CDS (unsupported ones excluded).

infos.description: Findings at severity info — coverage notes, never defect claims.

omitted.description: Findings the report cap dropped. The error/warning/info counts above are taken BEFORE the cap, so they stay true of the files even when this is non-zero.

rulesRun.description: Distinct rules that were not gated out by strict/requires.

suppressedByUnknown.description: How often a "X must be declared" rule stayed silent because a statement it could not read might have been that X.

truncated.description: True when the finding cap or a parser cap cut the report short.

unknownConstructs.description: Statements outside our grammar (RAP000 candidates), before the 50-per-file report cap.

warnings.description: Findings at severity warning — advisory rules and release gates.

validated.description: Checked by abap-mcp's own RAP parser + rule set at the stamped grammar/rules version. It does NOT claim abaplint parsed it, that SAP's parser would accept it, or that the object would activate.

title: Check a RAP behavior/service definition
